turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me.
Don't thank me. Who decided on that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. If his reading level is years ahead, then why does he have a zero?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Then why are we here? You still haven't answered me: who decided, and on what basis.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
You're not getting my blessing for something you haven't described. Tell me what's in front of you besides a software score, or I'm going upstairs.
